usedFor: Zoom runs the meetings and Google Drive holds the files. When “When a meeting summary is completed” fires, “Share File With Anyone” can give attendees a link to a Drive file, such as the notes.

bestTemplate.name: “When a meeting summary is completed” in Zoom, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A summary appears once the meeting is over, which is when a shared file is useful, and the action sets Viewer, Commenter or Editor access on a shareable link.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” makes the file reachable by link, so anyone holding the link can open it. Choose Viewer unless people must edit.
